flags.message: codex-baseline reports two rate-limited CourtListener precedent searches in reasoning.md and retrieval.md, but its staged retrieval_log.json contains no corresponding search calls. The logged calls are captured, so this is a limitation of the available call inventory rather than a claim that unobserved results were empty. The search failures cannot be independently verified. No outcome exposure is indicated, and the forward-mode leakage assessment remains not_applicable. Evaluation completed for all three candidates.
